_doc: Opening books (05 s7.3, R0 C2-14, AI-24) on the R0 B.6 start kit (Core, Refinery, Shipyard with launch pad, Vehicle Bay, 1 Harvester mining, 800 Ore / 300 Ice): 3 doctrines x 2 variants, picked by weighted draw on the AI RNG. Grammar and location tokens: 05 s7.3 (opening_book.gd, BuildPlanner.resolve_site). No storage_silo (O-4); every build outpost follows an order move to the same site and carries when: presence (AI-23 refuses a book that breaks it). A book hands over to the reactive planner (05 s7.5) after its last step, at the latest at book_end_s 300. Each *_standard is the 05 s7.3 text refit to the measured income of a Normal bot in the SC-41 world after BUG-4 (cradle, slots 0 and 2, seed 41): every step it keeps is executed before the hand-over in both slots, and no `when` is a time chosen around stall_s. Steps whose 05 time is at or after the hand-over, or which that income does not pay by 5:00, are cut and listed in the book's _doc as reactive phase after the hand-over (05 s7.5). Per-step times: the AI-24 PR.

build_orders._doc: vanguard_standard: 05 s7.3 steps 1-15 verbatim. Measured (SC-41 world): home-trap Outpost placed 2:50, last step (set_replenish dart 3) 4:22 in both slots; longest funds wait 44 s (ice_extractor). Cut, reactive phase after the hand-over (05 s7.5): raid harvester_line with dart:3 when t>=300&have:dart>=3 (05's time is the hand-over itself; raids after it are the military manager's, AI-27); order move dart|scout to contested_field when t>=420|ore>=900 + build outpost when presence (05 time 7:00; s7.5 Expansion places the contested Outpost at the book's time).
vanguard_rush: AI-24 variant (05 s7.3 names *_rush): 2 Darts first, early home-trap Outpost (t>=60), then a Dart raid at 4:00; costs 1,250 Ore, completes with no stall.

bulwark_standard: 05 s7.3 text with 3 changes. (1) The 2 relay_pylon toward:cold_trap:home are replaced by order move + build outpost at outpost_site:home_trap: on the R0 B.6 layout the home Cold Trap is 1,700 m from the Core, 2 Pylons (450 + 220 m, 250 m radius) do not reach it and the ice_extractor of 05 waited on WAIT_SITE; the Outpost covers it (the Extractor waits have:outpost>=1). (2) The move goes out when ore>=520 (Outpost 450 x bulwark cost_ore 1.15, rounded to 5 by DoctrineResolver), so the escort finds the Outpost paid when it arrives: the escort Dart orbits the site and leaves on fuel (AI-24 PR), so a funds wait at the site loses presence. (3) The book ends at flak_battery. Measured (SC-41 world): Outpost placed 2:26, last step 3:12 in both slots; the Flak is paid from the 4:20 delivery, so the next 05 step (pad) would wait past stall_s. Cut, reactive phase after the hand-over (05 s7.5 Pads, Defence, Expansion): pad; hangar (have:pad>=1, C2-14); produce lancer 1; set_replenish dart 2; sensor_mast at approach:nearest_enemy; order move dart|lancer to contested_field when t>=330 + build outpost when presence (05 time 5:30).
bulwark_greedy: AI-24 variant: 2 extra Harvesters and the Pylon chain before the first Dart, home-trap Outpost at t>=120, tower after; costs 1,650 Ore.

foundry_standard: 05 s7.3 steps 1-11 verbatim, then set_replenish harvester 6 (05 step 14; the kept steps keep their 05 order). Measured (SC-41 world): home-trap Outpost placed 3:08 / 3:12, last step 3:55 / 3:59. Cut, reactive phase after the hand-over (05 s7.5): order move dart|scout to contested_field when t>=270 + build outpost when presence (05 time 4:30: the only Dart has returned to refuel after escorting the home Outpost; measured, the move goes out at 4:29 and no unit is present at the 2,365 m site by 5:00; s7.5 Expansion places it at the book's time); build reactor near outpost when t>=600 (foundry reactor_unlock_s 600, after the hand-over).
foundry_greedy: AI-24 variant: 2 Harvesters first, home-trap Outpost at t>=100, second Refinery, Extractor, Hauler, one tower; costs 2,100 Ore.
